name: Key Personnel
title: Key Personnel and Resources
text: The individuals identified as key personnel in a Statement of Work shall be assigned to the Services for the period it states, and the Service Provider shall not remove or reassign any of them except on death, illness, resignation, dismissal or the Client's written consent. Where a key person must be replaced, the Service Provider shall propose a replacement of at least equivalent skill and experience, shall give the Client a reasonable opportunity to object on reasonable grounds, and shall bear the cost of familiarising the replacement.

legal_basis.note: Where the parties intended performance by a particular person, that intention governs; naming key personnel is how that intention is recorded.

invalid_if: The clause restrains a named individual from leaving the Service Provider's employment, which is void under section 27 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 as against that individual.
authoring_note: The last sentence carries the misclassification risk and should be read together with CORE_RELATIONSHIP_OF_PARTIES_001. Confirm whether a minimum notice period for planned replacements should be stated.

source_provenance.heading: Headings 12 and 16 (Personnel, Facilities and Equipment).
source_provenance.extraction_note: Extracted as a legal PROPOSITION from a client-supplied Master Service Agreement checklist, then drafted afresh against Indian law. The source was not copied: it mixed US regulatory material (HIPAA, the False Claims Act, 42 U.S.C. s.1320a-7a, the Red Flag Rules) that cannot apply here, India Post Payments Bank provisions tied to the RBI outsourcing regime that must not be made generic, and unresolved '*' placeholders in economically material terms. None of that entered this clause; the statutory basis was researched independently.

_split_note: D4.5-C. This clause previously carried two propositions with different applicability: personal performance intended (ICA s.40, conditional on key_person_dependency) and the principal-employer allocation (Code on Wages s.43 / EPF s.8A, applicable to every services engagement). Gated on include_sla, BOTH were lost whenever service levels were not agreed. The text was severed at existing sentence boundaries so no new legal wording was authored; the employment-status sentences moved verbatim to SERVICE_PERSONNEL_STATUS_001.
